Evolution of a City: The Path - 3D Max 15 Hours

Andy CASA, UCL East


The Path from Timonster on Vimeo.


The movie about was created over a non stop 15 hour period to hit a deadline. Modeled by Timon of http://www.timononline.de/ it shows what can be archived in a short period of time.

We especially like the evolution to the cityscape and the rough and ready rendering gives it a nice 'urban grit'.
